summary: Track a labeled object region through a shot and emit per-frame tracking data as a content-addressed artifact. Launch coverage is thin: only the Blender adapter maps this capability (experimental); the shortfall is recorded as a coverage gap feeding Arena.

inputs.name: project
inputs.constraints: project whose first clip provides the tracking source

outputs.name: trackingData
outputs.constraints: per-frame marker positions/offsets; produced by the adapter's tracking run

parameters.name: targetLabel
parameters.description: Label for the tracked object (becomes the tracker track name).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Seed region as x,y,w,h in source pixels.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Tracking start time in the source clip.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Tracking end time in the source clip; omit to track to the clip end.

qualityDimensions.description: Drift of the tracked region across the shot.
Fraction of requested frames with tracking data.

costModel.notes: Local compute; scales with tracked frame count.

providerMappings.notes: Movie clip tracker markers seeded and tracked via generated bpy script. Headless marker-seeding is API-safe; the track_markers operator's headless availability is unverified in the Phase 1 sandbox (blender binary absent) — see gap.editor-track-object-launch-coverage.

notes: editor-adapter-contract.md §4: track-object outputs land as artifacts. Launch-set coverage shortfall is committed as gap.editor-track-object-launch-coverage (kind editor-coverage-gap) — MLT's vidstab provides stabilization not object tracking; Natron tracker setup is GUI-oriented in the declared scripting surface; FFmpeg/Kdenlive/LosslessCut expose no headless tracking.
